title: Google Releases Gemini 3.7 Flash: Comprehensive Upgrade in Coding Performance, Initial Price Reduction of Up to 50%
excerpt: On August 13, Google officially launched the new Gemini 3.7 Flash, just three weeks after the release of its predecessor, Gemini 3.6 Flash. Google positions it
content_html:
On August 13, Google officially launched the new Gemini 3.7 Flash, just three weeks after the release of its predecessor, Gemini 3.6 Flash. Google positions it as the strongest main model to date for code writing and AI Agent scenarios, attributing it to significant breakthroughs at the algorithm level.

The model has seen significant improvements in software engineering and logic tasks: the score on the FrontierCode benchmark test increased from 34.4% to 43.6%, and the DeepSWE test score rose from 49.0% to 65.3%. It also performs well in areas such as web development, document understanding, and business process automation, with overall performance exceeding Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra.

In terms of ecosystem deployment and cost control, Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available through API, AI Studio, and Antigravity. Its initial pricing is set at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, which is a direct 50% reduction compared to the initial price of 3.6 Flash (the prices of both models are now equal).

This promotional pricing is expected to last until the end of 2026. With performance breakthroughs and reduced costs in complex coding and autonomous agent areas, high-performance large models are accelerating the commercialization of large-scale application deployments.

content_html_zh:
8 月 13 日，谷歌正式推出了新款 Gemini 3.7 Flash，距离其前身 Gemini 3.6 Flash 发布仅三周。 谷歌将其定位为迄今为止针对代码编写和AI Agent场景最强的主要模型，将其归因于算法层面的重大突破。

该模型在软件工程和逻辑任务方面都有显着改进：FrontierCode 基准测试分数从 34.4% 上升到 43.6%，DeepSWE 测试分数从 49.0% 上升到 65.3%。 它还在 Web 开发、文档理解和业务流程自动化等领域表现出色，整体性能超过 Claude Sonnet 5 和 GPT-5.6 Terra。

在生态部署和成本控制方面，Gemini 3.7 Flash现已通过API、AI Studio和Antigravity提供。 其初始定价定为每百万输入代币 0.75 美元，每百万输出代币 3.75 美元，与 3.6 Flash 的初始价格相比直接降低了 50%（现在两种型号的价格相等）。

此次促销价格预计将持续到 2026 年底。 随着复杂编码和自主代理领域的性能突破和成本降低，高性能大型模型正在加速大规模应用部署的商业化。
